karsa-outskirts.name: Map: Karsa Outskirts
karsa-outskirts.author: Sixth Front
karsa-outskirts.description: A new battlefield. The armies deploy from the east and west and fight over a hilltop chapel, a rail depot, a sawmill and a radio hill in the south. The game restarts when you switch it on or off.

map-dust-ridge.name: Map: Dust Ridge
map-dust-ridge.author: Sixth Front
map-dust-ridge.description: A desert battlefield under a hard midday sun: a packed bazaar in the middle, walled compounds at the oasis, the pump station, the radar dome and the border post, rolling dunes and rocky ridges. Five flags. The game restarts when you switch it on or off.
script: // Paint the ground, bushes and trees in desert colours (only once per page: this map restarts the game)

map-iron-forest.name: Map: Iron Forest
map-iron-forest.author: Sixth Front
map-iron-forest.description: Dense, misty woods where you rarely see further than a hundred metres. Fight over a sawmill, a ranger tower you can climb, a logging camp, a hunting lodge and a stone quarry. The armies deploy from the east and west. Five flags. The game restarts when you switch it on or off.

map-old-town.name: Map: Old Town
map-old-town.author: Sixth Front
map-old-town.description: Street fighting in a whole city: a grid of streets and blocks packed with multi-storey buildings you can blow apart, around a rail yard, a cathedral, the city hall, a tram depot and the market hall. Five flags. The game restarts when you switch it on or off.

mode-capture-the-flag.name: Mode: Capture the Flag

mode-capture-the-flag.description: Each team has a flag in front of its HQ. Grab the enemy flag and carry it back to your own flag to score, but only while yours is safe at home. Dropped flags go home if a teammate touches them or after 20 seconds. First team to 3 captures wins, or the team ahead after 10 minutes. Bots attack, defend, escort carriers and chase thieves. Works on every map. The game restarts when you switch it on or off.

team-deathmatch.name: Team Deathmatch
team-deathmatch.author: Sixth Front
team-deathmatch.description: No flags, just the fight. Each side starts with 120 tickets and loses one for every soldier who dies for good. Bots hunt the enemy across the whole valley. Changes the map, so the game restarts when you switch it.

mode-gun-game.name: Mode: Gun Game
